item.title: ABC News: Missing 7-year-old boy found safe and well in Alice Springs
item.description: Northern Territory Police have this morning located a seven-year-old boy who had been missing in Alice Springs since yesterday.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Tributes flow for Molly Meldrum after death at age 83
item.description: Molly Meldrum, a giant of Australia's popular music and television industries, dies aged 83. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: NT Police seek public help in search for missing 7yo boy in Alice Springs
item.description: Police in Alice Springs are appealing to the community for help to find a seven-year-old boy who went missing near the town's CBD yesterday morning.

item.title: ABC News: Remote public housing tenants moved after two-year maintenance wait
item.description: Tanya Spider and Robin Dann say the WA government ignored repeated maintenance requests for two years at their Kimberley home, before an inquiry from the ABC sparked action.

item.title: ABC News: Sam Neill's final Australian role is as a mouthy magpie
item.description: Dario Russo's debut feature film, The Fox, spins a quintessentially Aussie fable about being careful what you wish for.

item.title: ABC News: Molly Meldrum, the 'most important person in pop', dies aged 83
item.description: Molly Meldrum, a highly influential figure in Australia's music industry as a critic, producer, interviewer and television presenter, has died.

item.title: ABC News: Democrats clinch their largest House majority since 1992
item.description: The milestone sets up a divided government, with the Senate also in Democratic hands and a Republican president in the White House.

item.title: ABC News: New life as mushroom farmer after lifesaving neurosurgery
item.description: A near-death experience convinced Emma Court to ditch her four-hour commute to a corporate job in Brisbane and start farming fancy, nutrient-packed fungi.

item.title: ABC News: Logan man accused of wife's stabbing murder set to face court
item.description: Police were called to a Slacks Creek house shortly before midnight on Saturday, where they found Christine Moe with a single stab wound to the chest.

item.title: ABC News: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot calls West Bank arson attacks 'Jewish terrorism'
item.description: Settlers set fire to vehicles and homes in several Palestinian villages overnight, drawing one of the sharpest condemnations yet from the politician charged with forming Israel's next government.

item.title: ABC News: Joeys come back to Earth with frustrating World Cup result
item.description: Australia faces a nervy wait to secure its place in the knockout stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup after Denmark holds it to a scoreless draw.

item.title: ABC News: Storms to hit south-western Qld as heatwave lingers in far north
item.description: The weather bureau is warning of severe storms west of Charleville, while the south-east could see storms returning later in the week.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Red imported fire ants found in Western Sydney
item.description: One of the world's worst invasive species is found in Sydney for the second time in as many months.

item.title: ABC News: Council allows private land burials for those who 'belong to the land'
item.description: Few rules govern spreading ashes after a person dies, but burial outside a cemetery is approved only in exceptional circumstances. In South Australia, a local council is about to make private burials easier.
